Introduction

REKIREM is a 4-member South Korean live idol girl group. The group consists of Mika, Pichu, Myai, and Aejeong. All of the members, except Mika, were previously on the show Girls Frontier. They had their debut stage on March 8th, 2025. On May 8, 2025, It was announced that Kyo had her exclusive contract with REKIREM's management terminated due to violations of regulations. Mika was later added to the group on May 24, 2025.
